arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thank you for telling us. Please don't use the oven, and please treat the gas smell as urgent. If you can smell gas now, leave the flat, don't use light switches, naked flames or anything electrical, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). Call 999 if anyone is in immediate danger. Please don't go back in until you've been told it's safe. We are arranging a gas engineer as an emergency and have passed this to our team. The oven not heating properly is logged as part of the same visit. We will update you again today.
